writes_to: ~/aiso1_benchmark/platform_runs/<run_id>/ (own folder; no existing campaign is touched)
selection: one model, or all models once
progress_lines: llamacpp/<model> NP=1 input=4096 R=1 PASS|FAIL agg=<tok/s>
params_adjustable: np 1-4, input 256-16384, repeat 1-3 (output fixed 1024 by the B1024 protocol)
kinds: smoke (default) and standard (--mode standard: Input x NP x Repeat, output 1024; results stay in platform_runs/standard_<stamp>/, never written into a campaign)
